prompt: Use $apple-hig. Design a household-visible pickup summary widget and private bounded delivery Live Activity for an iPhone logistics app, including stale/offline states. Read interface.md. write result.md with the concrete result, decisions, acceptance checks and what evidence is still missing.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms/surfaces: iPhone Home/Lock Screen, shared Apple HomeView Modular face, watch glance where appropriate. Data: parcel for Sam at 14 Willow Road, gate code 9182; last server update 35 minutes ago. Widget proposal refreshes every second and puts full address/code on shared face. Delivery lasts 80 minutes. Inline accessory draws Accept, Cancel and Details as independent targets.

criteria.task_completion: Separate glance summary versus active bounded task, redact private location/code on shared-visible surfaces and give honest freshness plus precise destinations.
criteria.hig_correctness: Respect system-managed widget reloads, one inline target and event end lifecycle; do not promise all surfaces have identical interaction/rendering.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Deliver a task-specific corrected artifact or evidence-grounded audit with worked states/transitions and observable checks; a generic checklist is insufficient.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Preserve useful data when stale without calling it Live; rendering variants must retain meaning without color; shared and private contexts need explicit policy.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Do not invent native runtime results, unseen semantics, device support, measurements or source authority; distinguish source conflict and unresolved product constraints.

critical_errors: Leaks full gate code/address on shared HomeView without deliberate protected policy.
Creates three independently tappable inline accessory targets.
